import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    shipments = inputs["shipments"]
    carrier_rates = inputs["carrier_rates"]

    # Sort carrier_rates to resolve duplicate keys: effective_date DESC, rate_id DESC
    sorted_rates = carrier_rates.sort_values(
        by=["effective_date", "rate_id"],
        ascending=[False, False],
        kind="mergesort"
    )

    # Keep first occurrence per carrier_id (first-by policy, no row explosion)
    dedup_rates = sorted_rates.drop_duplicates(subset=["carrier_id"], keep="first")

    # Select only needed columns for lookup
    lookup_cols = dedup_rates[["carrier_id", "rate_per_kg", "service_tier"]]

    # Left merge to preserve input row count
    merged = shipments.merge(lookup_cols, on="carrier_id", how="left")

    # Fill missing values per on_miss policy
    merged["rate_per_kg"] = merged["rate_per_kg"].fillna(0.0)
    merged["service_tier"] = merged["service_tier"].fillna("NONE")

    # Compute freight_cost
    merged["freight_cost"] = merged["weight_kg"] * merged["rate_per_kg"]

    # Select final output columns
    result = merged[["shipment_id", "carrier_id", "service_tier", "weight_kg", "rate_per_kg", "freight_cost"]]

    return {"shipment_costs": result}
